body:
scripts/render-board-artifact.mjs builds its render node by hand and fills neither `reads`
nor `state`, violating the §30 floor's promise that both members are always present on every
host (found when a hollow-test mutant dropped the n.state guard and the mirror rail went red
— T208's build, 2026-08-21). The script is NOT frozen: T108 and T112 list it under scope
only, and the frozen set is computed from rails globs — so this is a plain edit, no
authorization ceremony. The floor's normative text lives in the working spec
.adlc/specs/30-renderer-dual-target.md (~line 1259: reads AND state present as empty objects
on first paint) and in src/gateway/renderers.ts (~115-125 required RenderNode members;
~574-589 the door building {} for a plain GET) — spec/30 does not exist as a landed section;
SPEC.md reserves the number.

Related §30 decision discovered the same night, parked here: the board's as-of control cannot
be a live slider because a RenderFn is a pure function of its node and the node carries no
clock — the honest fix is the door putting `now` on the floor's node, which is a §30
amendment (Myk's ground). This ticket's build half is the mirror script; the `now` decision
rides to Myk with T214-class design work.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The mirror script's render node carries reads and state per the §30 floor, and the mirror
    output is byte-identical for the current board (two-sided: floor satisfied, behavior
    unchanged). Verify: the existing mirror rail plus a floor assertion in a new test file if
    the frozen shards permit no edit.
(b) (removed — the script is not frozen; criterion (a) is the whole build.)

Merge tier: repair of a stated floor — self-merge on the ordinary bar.
title: The board mirror script violates the §30 floor — a hand-built render node without reads or state
